# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**My pick: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it Best Overall after testing 30+ models. It's a chrome stand with a 15W Qi2 iPhone pad, fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7 and newer, and an AirPods pad on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. The 36W power supply is included. WIRED lists it at $98, or about $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. Those prices may have changed. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

## Other good options

- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max, $169.** It delivers Qi2 25W to the iPhone and has a weighted base. The power adapter isn't included, and you need one rated at 40W. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Cheapest: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station, about $40 on Amazon.** It's the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has found. It charges at 15W and includes a charger and cable. The Apple Watch puck is a separate piece that slots into the back. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Best for sleeping: Nimble Podium, $130.** Your devices lie flat, so screens stay out of sight. It supports Qi2 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Best for travel: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2), about $80.** It folds slim, charges at 15W, and includes a 40W power supply. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/))
- **Best foldable for desk and travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W, $129.99.** Macworld says it's the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plugs. It's heavier than rivals at 399g. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))
- **Fast with cooling: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W).** It has an active cooling fan and a 50W adapter. The store price is $99.99, or about $82 with code PARTNER18 at ESR's US store. That code is listed as expiring 2026-12-31, so check it at checkout. [Buy at ESR](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) (this is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you). ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand))

## Things to know

- **25W only helps on newer iPhones.** ESR says full 25W applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Other models get 20W or 15W. WIRED also notes that 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin is enough for most people.
- **Check your AirPods case.** It needs to support wireless charging to use the AirPods pad.
- **Apple Watch needs to be Series 7 or newer** for fast charging on these stands.

I couldn't open the retailer pages, and the Belkin, Nomad, Nimble, Anker and Satechi links above go to the review articles, which link to the retailers. The prices come from those reviews and may have changed.
